title: #316 Take Risks
prompt: Some people like to do only what they already do well. Other people prefer to try new things and take risks. What is your opinion?

promptSegments.text: Some people like to do only what they already do well.
Other people prefer to try new things and take risks.

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.
A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?

modelPlan.focus: Discuss the benefits and drawbacks of sticking to familiar tasks versus embracing new challenges, ultimately arguing that a balance is key for personal growth.
keyArguments: While specializing in familiar tasks can provide stability and mastery, it may lead to stagnation.
Embracing new challenges fosters growth, adaptability, and innovation, which are essential for long-term success.
